name: bim_run_canary_tests
author: hprebar
title: Run canary tests of the HP clash matrix
description: HEAVY: runs a few of the HP clash-matrix tests written by bim_sync_clash_tests to prove they catch real clashes before the BIM coordinator runs them all (Clash Detective > Run All). Default picks up to 3 up-to-date tests with non-empty sets, HIGH priority first, one per discipline pair (ARC-STR, MEP-STR, ARC-MEP...); ruleIds picks them explicitly. Needs 'Allow heavy operations' ticked in the bridge window; a run cannot be interrupted or undone and may take minutes — save the file first. Returns each test's result counts by status and its run time; compare with a manual Run of the same test.

count.description: How many canaries when ruleIds is empty

ruleIds.description: Run exactly these rules' tests, e.g. ["HP_M2_S5"]; each must be up to date with non-empty sets

notes: Picks tests via HPNavis.BIMCoordinator.CoordinatorTools.CanaryTestNames; runs them here with DocumentClashTests.TestsRunTest (so the bridge's heavy gate sees the call), resolving each test by name right before its run because a run disposes the wrapper handed to it.
